ops.text: daemonkit v0.14 migration (cc-review 9740f21) fails closed on pre-v0.14 controller state: any existing ~/.cc-review/v1/processes.db from the v0.10 runtime makes EVERY cc-review command error "service: initialized controller state is missing bucket \"replacement\"" (daemonkit service/controller_state.go:187) — even `status`, client-side, with no daemon running and no remedy hint. Real users upgrading the plugin will brick until they delete the file by hand. Needs an archive-and-reinit path like the store's ArchiveUnsupportedSchema (or bucket backfill). Workaround used during stacked-diff E2E: mv processes.db processes.db.v010.bak → v0.14 initializes fresh.
